title: Serial Studio extension catalog entry (v2)
description: The info.json / manifest entry an extension repository publishes (spec 0075, K3/K5). Every installable file carries a SHA-256 digest and a byte size: the installer downloads into a staging directory, verifies each file against its digest, and only then swaps it over the installed version. An entry whose files are bare strings is catalog v1 and is refused -- there is nothing to verify a download against.

schemaVersion.description: Catalog format version. v1 (files as plain strings, no digests) is refused by the installer.

id.description: Stable package identifier; also one path component of the install directory, so separators and parent references are excluded by the pattern.

type.description: Package kind. The install location is chosen from the local package type, never from this field alone.

version.description: Compared numerically against the installed version, so a lower remote version is never offered as an update.

platforms.description: Per-platform overrides keyed by "<os>/<arch>", "<os>/*" or "*"; each override may carry its own files array of the same shape.

path.description: Repository-relative path, also the path inside the install directory. The installer refuses any resolved path that leaves that directory.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes. A download whose digest differs aborts the install and leaves the previously installed version untouched.

size.description: Byte size, checked before the digest so an oversized body is rejected without hashing it.
